template:
MATCH methodPath = (anchorMethod:方法)
  -[:链中下一节点*0..5]->(outboundMethod:方法)
MATCH (outboundMethod)-[:下游调用]->(downstreamApi:下游API)
WHERE
  <TARGET_METHOD_FILTER> AND
  (
    size(relationships(methodPath)) = 0 OR
    ALL(
      pathRelationship IN relationships(methodPath)
      WHERE
        pathRelationship.路径签名 =
        relationships(methodPath)[0].路径签名
    )
  ) AND
  (
    size(relationships(methodPath)) <= 1 OR
    ALL(
      index IN range(1, size(relationships(methodPath)) - 1)
      WHERE
        relationships(methodPath)[index].位置索引 =
        relationships(methodPath)[index - 1].位置索引 + 1
    )
  )
OPTIONAL MATCH (downstreamApi)-[:目标服务]->(targetService:微服务)
OPTIONAL MATCH (downstreamApi)-[:外部调用]->(targetApi:上游API)
OPTIONAL MATCH (targetEntryMethod:方法)-[:服务于]->(targetApi)
RETURN DISTINCT
  anchorMethod.全限定名 AS 目标方法,
  [method IN nodes(methodPath) | method.全限定名] AS 方法路径,
  downstreamApi.API路径 AS 下游API,
  targetService.服务名称 AS 下游服务,
  targetApi.API路径 AS 目标上游API,
  targetEntryMethod.全限定名 AS 目标入口方法

MATCH rootPath = (anchorMethod:方法)-[:接口调用|链中下一节点*0..10]->(leafMethod:方法)
MATCH (anchorMethod)-[anchorClassRelation:归属于]->(anchorClass:类)-[anchorServiceRelation:归属于]->(sourceService:微服务)
OPTIONAL MATCH (anchorMethod)-[sourceEntryRelation:服务于]->(sourceApi:上游API)
WITH anchorMethod, leafMethod, rootPath, sourceService, sourceApi, anchorClassRelation, anchorClass, anchorServiceRelation, sourceEntryRelation, relationships(rootPath) AS pathRelationships, [relationship IN relationships(rootPath) WHERE type(relationship) = '链中下一节点'] AS orderedRelationships, anchorMethod.图谱版本 AS graphVersion
WHERE <TARGET_METHOD_FILTER>
  AND anchorClassRelation.图谱版本 = graphVersion
  AND anchorClass.图谱版本 = graphVersion
  AND anchorServiceRelation.图谱版本 = graphVersion
  AND sourceService.图谱版本 = graphVersion
  AND (sourceEntryRelation IS NULL OR (sourceEntryRelation.图谱版本 = graphVersion AND sourceApi.图谱版本 = graphVersion))
  AND ALL(node IN nodes(rootPath) WHERE node.图谱版本 = graphVersion)
  AND ALL(relationship IN pathRelationships WHERE relationship.图谱版本 = graphVersion)
  AND ALL(index IN range(0, size(pathRelationships) - 1) WHERE type(pathRelationships[index]) <> '接口调用' OR index = 0)
  AND size([relationship IN pathRelationships WHERE type(relationship) = '接口调用']) <= 1
  AND (size(orderedRelationships) = 0 OR ALL(relationship IN orderedRelationships WHERE relationship.路径签名 = orderedRelationships[0].路径签名))
  AND (size(orderedRelationships) <= 1 OR ALL(index IN range(1, size(orderedRelationships) - 1) WHERE orderedRelationships[index].位置索引 = orderedRelationships[index - 1].位置索引 + 1))
RETURN DISTINCT anchorMethod.全限定名 AS 根方法, graphVersion AS 图谱版本, 0 AS 层级, 'local' AS 链路类型, sourceService.服务名称 AS 源服务, sourceApi.API路径 AS 源API路径, sourceApi.HTTP方法 AS 源HTTP方法, anchorMethod.全限定名 AS 源方法, [method IN nodes(rootPath) | method.全限定名] AS 方法路径, null AS 下游API路径, null AS 目标服务, null AS 目标API路径, null AS 目标HTTP方法, leafMethod.全限定名 AS 目标方法, null AS 消息交换机, null AS 消息队列, null AS 路由键
UNION
MATCH rootPath = (anchorMethod:方法)-[:接口调用|链中下一节点*0..10]->(leafMethod:方法)
MATCH (anchorMethod)-[anchorClassRelation:归属于]->(anchorClass:类)-[anchorServiceRelation:归属于]->(sourceService:微服务)

MATCH (leafMethod)-[downstreamRelation:下游调用]->(downstreamApi:下游API)

OPTIONAL MATCH (downstreamApi)-[externalRelation:外部调用]->(targetApi:上游API)
OPTIONAL MATCH (targetEntryMethod:方法)-[targetEntryRelation:服务于]->(targetApi)
WITH anchorMethod, leafMethod, rootPath, sourceService, sourceApi, downstreamApi, targetService, targetApi, targetEntryMethod, anchorClassRelation, anchorClass, anchorServiceRelation, sourceEntryRelation, downstreamRelation, targetServiceRelation, externalRelation, targetEntryRelation, relationships(rootPath) AS pathRelationships, [relationship IN relationships(rootPath) WHERE type(relationship) = '链中下一节点'] AS orderedRelationships, anchorMethod.图谱版本 AS graphVersion
